research_rationale:

Its garbled signing line is corroborated by the read Photius text's July 30, 1935 line; no legal ending is inferred from that signing date. The sole operative paragraph makes the exemption and continuance coextensive with a fixed calendar term. The calendar limitation itself ends prospective force; no contingent performance event must be supplied. Earlier death or separation is not established and is not asserted. A hypothetical later independent further exemption would require its own authority and would not silently rewrite this grant. The supplied name search found no later held name match; numbered USC/eCFR and catalog searches found no hits. These are accepted as bounded counterevidence searches, with their stated omissions: 85 orders lack held text, name matching is not identity authentication, the catalog begins in 1937, and the USC edition ends October 9, 2026. None is treated as proof from silence or as the ending source. No positive contrary lead remains. One personal, time-limited grant exhausts the inventory; accrued effects do not keep it operative. This is provisional same-family AI production, with human certification false and independent whole-case review still required.
